title: Approve overtime requests
hint: Overtime requests from workers. Tap one to check it against that day's clock-ins and daily report, then approve or reject.
reportedEndNote: Approving rewrites the report with this time and it goes into payroll (currently counted up to the fixed end time).
reportedStartNote: Approving rewrites the report start with this time and it goes into payroll (currently counted from the fixed start time).
evidenceTitle: Clock-ins and report for this day
noReport: No daily report yet for this day
evidenceNote: If there are no clock-ins and no report, check with the worker before deciding (approving relaxes that day's input limits).
mine: You cannot approve your own request. Ask another approver.
rejectNotePlaceholder: e.g. Please tell us what work required overtime and apply again with the reason.
rejectHint: The comment appears on the worker's overtime page and notifications. They can apply again with a reason.

err.APPROVE_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to approve.
err.SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN: You cannot approve your own request. Ask another approver.
err.not_found: This request was not found (it may have been cancelled).
err.other: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
